description: Baseline run exposed harness bug: autoresearch.sh fed JPEG inputs directly to jxle (expects PPM/PNG), returning fallback parity_score=999999.
Fix autoresearch harness to convert JPEG corpus inputs to PPM for jxle and compute real parity metrics; baseline parity_score now 243.54 (mean size -36.84%, mean PSNR gap -12.18 dB).

Make libjxl comparison fair for JPEG inputs by forcing lossy mode (--lossless_jpeg=0) in autoresearch harness; parity_score drops to 24.11 with realistic size/PSNR gaps (mean size +8.97%, mean PSNR gap -0.67 dB).
Fix benchmark fairness: force lossy libjxl comparison on JPEG inputs (--lossless_jpeg=0) in autoresearch harness, reducing parity_score to 24.11.
Tried adding a light AC quantization dead-zone (|v|<0.22->0) in quantize_ac to reduce token noise. No measurable parity_score change on corpus.
Tried widening effort-7 candidate budget (max_total_encodes 36->64) to improve parity choices. No measurable change on parity corpus.
Detected harness flaw: autoresearch.sh reused stale release binaries and did not rebuild after source edits, invalidating experiments with unchanged metrics.
Fix harness invalidation by rebuilding jxle/jxl_cli on every autoresearch run; new measured baseline parity_score is 21.12 (mean size +11.79%, mean PSNR gap -0.25 dB).
Tried lowering AQ quant_ac scaling from 1.25 to 1.15 (closer to libjxl constants). Result regressed parity_score to 24.11 with larger PSNR deficit.
Tried forcing flat-graphic path to uniform quant candidate only; run crashed (parity_score fallback 999999), indicating encoder/decode failure in harness.
Tried fairness tweak feeding cjxl from converted PPM instead of JPEG path. Metrics unchanged vs current best, so no parity gain.
Tried always enabling gaborish signaling (remove flat-graphic gab disable). Slight parity regression: parity_score 21.18 (worse size, minimal PSNR change).
Tried libjxl-style non-gaborish IQF distance scaling, but experiment remained on regressed gaborish branch state and parity stayed worse (21.18). Discarding.
Tried neutralizing X/B dequant multipliers for detected flat graphics (x_dm=1.0,b_dm=1.0). No parity_score change; large encode-time secondary regression.
Tried stronger AQ scaling (quant_ac factor 1.35). It over-spent bits: mean size gap rose to +13.68% despite PSNR improvement, worsening parity_score to 21.31.
Baseline verification run confirming parity_score=21.12 at current HEAD. No changes.
Switch single-pass HybridUint from (4,1,2) to (4,2,0) matching libjxl default. Small but consistent size reduction across corpus; parity_score 21.12->21.01.
Tried recalculating uniform candidate base_raw_quant relative to actual global_scale (0.39/d path). Regressed parity_score to 21.94 - the old inconsistent rq was accidentally beneficial.
Tried using 0.79/d for AQ global_scale (matching libjxl Falcon fast path). Severe parity regression (32.62) due to coarser raw_quant resolution destroying AQ map precision.
Tried removing AQ scaling (quant_ac=0.765/d, no 1.25x factor). Files smaller (-3.9% mean) but PSNR gap much worse (-1.32 dB), parity_score regressed to 33.59.
Removed dead-zone (|v|<0.22) from quantize_ac, relying on standard 0.5 rounding. No measurable change - dead-zone was already subsumed by round().
Tried overriding global_scale for flat graphics to match libjxl Falcon, but adaptive_map raw_quant values became inconsistent, causing severe PSNR regression (-4.65 dB worst case).
Switch modular DC HybridUint from (4,1,2) to (4,2,0) matching libjxl default. Small but consistent size win; parity_score 21.01->20.98, Webkit max_size_pct 35.47->35.39.
Tried matching libjxl's distance-dependent EPF iters (1 for gab, 0 for flat). Marginal parity regression: 20.98->20.99. Current quantization tuning benefits from epf_iters=2.
Added DCT8x8-only as explicit transform candidate (matching libjxl Falcon). No measurable parity change -- already included via build_default_transform_map in candidates.
Tried AQ scaling factor 1.20 (from 1.25). Better size (-10.2%) but worse PSNR (-0.45 dB), parity_score 21.26 (worse). The 20x PSNR weight dominates.
Tried AQ scaling factor 1.30 (from 1.25). PSNR now slightly positive (+0.03 dB mean) but size overhead increased to 12.80%. Net parity_score 21.21 (worse than 20.98).
Use --bare codestream output (skip JXL container) for fair size comparison with libjxl. Saves ~40 bytes per file; parity_score 20.98->20.81, Webkit gap 35.39->34.60.
Tried changing HF metadata HybridUint from (4,1,2) to (4,2,0). Slight regression (20.81->20.85) - the original config is better for HF metadata content.
Tried using encode_modular_signed_stream for HF metadata (flat 1D). Crashed - decoder expects proper channel layout, not 1D stream.
Tried reducing num_contexts from 15 to 1 for flat images. Crash: context indices must match decoder's block context map expectations.
Added per-channel predictor selection via multi-leaf tree for modular DC encoding. No improvement -- single histogram context doesn't capture per-channel statistics.
Tried adding Average predictor (6) for modular DC. Severe PSNR regression (-26 dB) - predictor 6 semantics don't match between encoder/decoder implementations.
Baseline re-check after context compaction. Current best: parity_score=20.81, mean_size_pct=+11.47%, mean_psnr_gap=-0.25dB, max_size_pct=34.60% (Webkit).
Add ANS entropy coding for modular DC streams, competing against Huffman per-predictor. Massive improvement: parity_score 20.81->13.87, mean_size_pct 11.47%->3.04%, max_size_pct 34.60%->8.29%.
Add ANS entropy coding for HF metadata modular sections, competing vs Huffman. parity_score 13.87->13.82, mean_size_pct 3.04%->0.89%. Most images now within 1% of libjxl size.
Add softer uniform quant candidate (base_raw_quant-1). parity_score 13.82->10.17, mean_size -3.80%, max_size +0.64%. Photos now at parity or smaller. Webkit PSNR (-1.87dB) still dominates.
Added base_raw_quant-2 uniform candidate. Severe regression -- too aggressive quant wins size-only competition, destroying PSNR across all images.
Match libjxl EPF iters (2->1 at d=1.0). Slight regression: PSNR gap worsened -0.433->-0.439 because our quant was tuned assuming epf_iters=2 smoothing.
Force rq=1 for flat graphics. Same parity_score (10.17). The PSNR gap persists even at minimum quant, meaning the gap is NOT from quantization but from XYB/transform/EPF chain.
Remove AC dead-zone (v.abs() < 0.22). No change -- dead-zone was already subsumed by rounding.
Changed AQ global_scale from 0.39/d to 0.79/d. Severe regression -- unbalanced DC quant and AQ map conversion across all images.
Reduced AQ scale 1.25->1.15. Regression: photo PSNR worsened (-0.43->-0.56 mean) without helping Webkit.
Increased AQ scale 1.25->1.35. No change -- softer_rq candidate already dominates for all images.
Force Falcon-style separate encode for flat graphics. Massive regression -- 163% size overhead and PSNR worse. The separate path's quant calibration is completely wrong.
Use Falcon global_scale for flat graphics. Regression - PSNR degraded to -4.64 dB, worse than before. Quant calibration fundamentally mismatched.
Reduced AQ scale from 1.25 to 1.20. Regression: PSNR gap widened -0.43->-0.52 outweighing size gains.
AQ scale 1.30. No change -- uniform rq=5 candidate always wins regardless of AQ scaling.
Removed softer_rq candidate. PSNR improved -0.43->-0.25 but size regressed -3.80%->+0.89%. Net regression.
Changed global_scale computation from 0.39/d to 0.55/d. Severe PSNR regression (-5.8 dB worst). The intermediate value still breaks AQ calibration.
Competitive HybridUint config selection for modular ANS (tried 4 configs). No improvement -- (4,2,0) already optimal. Added 2s encode overhead.
Changed x_qm_scale from 3 to 2 (neutral X channel weighting). Regression -- photo PSNR worsened (-0.43->-0.53) as quality balance shifted unfavorably.
Falcon global_scale for flat graphics (v2). Regression confirmed after rebuild: -4.64 dB worst PSNR.
Falcon path for flat graphics (v3, clean rebuild). Still regression to 21.25. The Falcon global_scale produces systematically worse PSNR despite finer AC steps.
Added Select(4) and Average(3) predictors for modular DC. Severe PSNR regression (-11 dB) -- predictor implementations don't match decoder.
Add per-channel ANS histograms for modular DC (multi-leaf tree splitting by channel). parity_score 10.17->10.04, all images now smaller than libjxl (max_size -0.29%).
Removed aggressive rq=5 candidate. PSNR improved (-0.43 -> -0.25 dB) but size regressed (+7.48% max), net worse.
Added rq=7 (finer quant) as additional candidate alongside rq=5,6. Never wins (rq=5 always smallest), only adds encode time.
Competitive HybridUint config (4,1,2 vs 4,2,0) for HF metadata. Negligible improvement (0.0004%).
Added rq=50 candidate for flat graphics. Competition still picks rq=5 (smallest file) -- per-size competition can't optimize PSNR.
Forced rq=10 for flat graphics. No change -- AC still all zero because gs=5111 is too low. Even rq=255 can't preserve AC at this global_scale.
Changed EPF iters from 2 to 1 (matching libjxl Falcon thresholds). Slight regression -- quant was tuned for 2 EPF iters, photos slightly worse with 1.
Add Select predictor (4) for modular DC encoding, matching decoder exactly. Small size improvement (mean_size -5.03% -> -5.21%), same parity score.
Add AverageWestAndNorth predictor (3) for modular DC. Tiny size improvement (mean_size -5.21% -> -5.24%), same parity score.

Implement extra_dc_precision=2 for all images. DC quantization 4x finer. MASSIVE improvement: parity 10.04->3.49. Webkit penalty eliminated (48.35 vs 44.77 dB). Photos slightly larger (+3% max). Fixed multi-group bug where extra_precision header was not written.
Baseline on jxl-encoder branch after cherry-picks. Fix quant_ac 1.15->1.25. parity=2.46.
RD-aware competition with exponent=2 + finer_rq=10 candidate. Massive regression: files 37% larger. Quality discount too aggressive, finer_rq always wins despite bloat. Revert.

Bias-aware AC quantization accounting for decoder AdjustQuantBias. Regression: parity 2.46->3.20. Bias correction shifts quantization decisions for small coefficients, making files larger (+2.24% max) without PSNR improvement. Revert.
Disable custom coefficient orders at effort 7. Reduces header overhead: parity 2.46->2.37, max_size 1.35%->0.94%. PSNR unchanged.
Disable entropy merge. Slight regression: parity 2.37->2.39. Merge helps both size and PSNR. Re-enable.
